ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback and for being a longtime Weber fan! We are sorry to hear about the trouble you are experiencing with reaching desired temperatures and cooking grates. We recommend turning off the middle burner and grill indirectly with the 2 outer burners to achieve lower temps. Those grates are actually "Reversible." The thin flat side of the cooking grate is ideal for more delicate food, such as fish and shrimp. The wider ridged side creates thick sear marks enhancing the flavor of your food! Please contact us if you have any other questions or concerns. Thanks!

Results.ReviewText:
I needed a new BBQ and have always gone with Weber. However, this model seems too difficult to control the heat.  Even if I turn all 3 burners to the lowest setting it shoots up to over 400 degrees.  So I finally decided to turn the valve on the tank way down so as not to have it fully open.  That seems to work better and helps control the heat.
Also, the cross members on the grill are raised higher that the up and down grill members.  This makes it difficult to turn anything that you are cooking with a spatula.  So I have turned the grill over for cooking anything that I may use a spatula with.  My other Webers that I have owned are not like this.  This seems like a mistake that the company should have noticed before releasing this model.  It's kind of a messy problem to have to be flipping the grill over and back depending on what you are cooking.

Results.ReviewText:
This grill was a replacement for about a 10 year Spirit that we previously had and which had the burner tubes pararallel to the front of the grill.  This new Spirit has the burners perpendicular to the front which make it harder to cook with just one burner lit, harder to use the warming rack in the back and harder to use the rotissierrie.  When you lit just one burner with the "old" Spirit configuration all the heat was right in front of you  and there was no direct heat under the warming rack.  Now if you light one burner there is always direct heat under the warming rack so it is hard to use the whole thing.  Same thing with the rotissierre, which is centered on the grill.  With the old configuration I could light all three burners and then after the meat is seared turn off the center burner or the center and the rear and have only indirect heat on meat.  Now with only one burner on, there will always be a portion of the meat with direct heat and the other end will be less done.  Going to be VERY hard to achieve a consistent doneness on anything on the rotissierrie.

I grill 3-4 times per week and all in all this grill is a major disappointment.  By reorienting the burners you eliminate the flexibility of using indirect heat in more flexible ways.  This grill is poorly engineered, poorly executed and doesn't come close the finesse you can achieve with the old Spirit. The propane tank is difficult to hand inside the cabinet and you have to be on your hands and knees.  Its almost like they didn't really cook on this grill when it was tested.  You would have noticed at least a few of these issues.  Weber can feel free to contact me about these issues.

46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
